description: Returns three monthly electricity prices of Georgia from the Georgian National Energy and Water Supply Regulatory Commission (GNERC), in tetri per kWh: the weighted average price of balancing electricity, the guaranteed capacity fee, and the price of the deregulated power plants. Give a period of at most 60 months from 2015-01. With no input, it returns the last 12 published months. Data from GNERC.

from.description: The first month, YYYY-MM, from 2015-01. Leave it empty for 11 months before to.

to.description: The last month, YYYY-MM. Leave it empty for the newest published month.

name: energy_list_prices

as_of.description: The instant at which GNERC last changed a price workbook, or at which the server read them, RFC 3339.

months.description: Each published month of the period, the oldest first.

balancing.description: The weighted average price of the balancing electricity sold in the month.

capacity_fee.description: The guaranteed capacity fee for each kWh.

deregulated.description: The price of the electricity bought from deregulated power plants to set the balancing price.

newest_month.description: The newest month that GNERC published, YYYY-MM.

source.description: The source of the data: Georgian National Energy and Water Supply Regulatory Commission (GNERC).

stale.description: True when GNERC did not answer and the server returns data it read before.

unit.description: The unit of each price: tetri per kWh. 100 tetri are 1 lari.

title: List the electricity prices of Georgia
